title: Co-Working Space Reimbursement and Usage Policy
content: Acme Corp encourages the use of certified co-working spaces as a productive alternative to home offices for remote employees. Approved co-working spaces are listed on the company intranet. Employees may use certified co-working spaces without VPN provided the space has achieved Acme Corp's standard network security certification. The company will reimburse up to $200 per month for co-working space membership fees with manager approval. Employees should not bring confidential printed materials to co-working spaces but may access digital systems on certified networks. This policy supersedes informal arrangements and is designed to support employee wellbeing.
